<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def glyph_at(fr, r0,r1,c0,c1):
    lines=fr.ascii.split('\n')
    g=[['B' if lines[r][c]=='B' else '.' for c in range(c0,c1)] for r in range(r0,r1)]
    rs=[i for i,row in enumerate(g) if 'B' in row]; cs=[j for row in g for j,ch in enumerate(row) if ch=='B']
    if not rs: return None
    r0b,r1b,c0b,c1b=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    return tuple(tuple('B' if g[i][j]=='B' else '.' for j in range(c0b,c1b+1)) for i in range(r0b,r1b+1))
def show(s): return ' '.join(''.join(r) for r in s) if s else 'None'
cycles={0:[('BBBBB','B.B.B','B.BBB','B...B','BBBBB'),('BBBBB','.B..B','.B..B','.BBBB','....B'),
('..B..','BBBBB','B.B.B','BBBBB','..B..'),('BBBB.','B..BB','B...B','BB..B','.BBBB'),
('..B..','BBBBB','B...B','B...B','BBBBB'),('BBBBB','B...B','BBBBB','.B.B.','.BBB.'),
('..BBB','..B.B','BBBBB','B.B..','BBB..')],
1:[('.BBBB','BB..B','B...B','B..BB','BBBB.'),('.BBBB','.B..B','BB..B','.B..B','.BBBB'),
('BBB..','B.BBB','B.B.B','B.BBB','BBB..'),('BBB..','B.B..','BBBBB','..B.B','..BBB'),
('BBBBB','B.B.B','BBB.B','B...B','BBBBB'),('BBBBB','B..B.','B..B.','BBBB.','B....'),
('.BBB.','.B.B.','BBBBB','.B.B.','.BBB.')] }
# I'm at slot1. Go to slot2,3,4 and cycle 7 each.
for slot in [2,3,4]:
    action(['RIGHT'])
    cyc=[]
    for k in range(7):
        action(['UP'])
        g=glyph_at(current_frame,51,58,15+7*slot,22+7*slot)
        cyc.append(g)
    cycles[slot]=cyc
    print(f"--- slot{slot} ---")
    for k,g in enumerate(cyc): print(f"  [{k}] {show(g)}")
import json
# store for next step via result
result=json.dumps({str(k):[list(r) for r in v] for k,v in cycles.items()})
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

def glyph_at(fr, r0,r1,c0,c1):
    lines=fr.ascii.split('\n')
    g=[['B' if lines[r][c]=='B' else '.' for c in range(c0,c1)] for r in range(r0,r1)]
    rs=[i for i,row in enumerate(g) if 'B' in row]; cs=[j for row in g for j,ch in enumerate(row) if ch=='B']
    if not rs: return None
    r0b,r1b,c0b,c1b=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    return tuple(tuple('B' if g[i][j]=='B' else '.' for j in range(c0b,c1b+1)) for i in range(r0b,r1b+1))
